# Grok Build: Event & Persistence Pipeline (Read-Only)

End-to-end flow: **sampler L2 parse → `SamplingEvent` → session actor → dual emit paths (buffered vs direct) → persistence actor → JSONL on disk → `session/load` replay → ACP/headless projections**.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  subgraph ingest [Ingest]
    L2["L2 stream parsers\n(responses/messages)"]
    SE["SamplingEvent"]
  end
  subgraph actor [Session actor]
  RB["ReplayBuffer\n(client debounce)"]
  ED["emit_buffered /\nemit_notification_direct"]
  end
  subgraph persist [Persistence actor]
  PM["PersistenceMsg"]
  MERGE["maybe_merge_notification"]
  JSONL["updates.jsonl +\nchat_history.jsonl"]
  end
  subgraph replay [Resume]
  PR["prepare_replay_lines"]
  FR["forward_raw_replay_line"]
  end
  L2 --> SE --> RB --> ED
  ED --> PM --> MERGE --> JSONL
  JSONL --> PR --> FR
```

---

## Evidence Table

| Area | Path(s) | Key symbol(s) | Behavior / contract | Limitations / ordering risks | ADDOM lesson |
|------|---------|---------------|---------------------|------------------------------|--------------|
| **L2 response parse** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-sampler/src/stream/responses.rs`, `.../messages.rs`, `.../stream/collect.rs` | `stream_*`, `collect_response`, `SamplingEvent` | HTTP/SSE chunks → `StreamStarted`, `ChannelToken`, `ToolCallDelta`, `Completed`/`Failed` | `ToolCallDelta.arguments_delta` not valid JSON alone; stream without terminal event → synthetic `Api` error | **Adopt** — separate streaming events from terminal `ConversationResponse` |
| **Canonical sampling events** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-sampler/src/events.rs` | `SamplingEvent`, `SamplingChannel`, `SamplingErrorKind` | Single enum for all provider backends; session maps to UI wire | Doom-loop / empty-response context only on some variants | **Adopt** — one internal event enum, multiple wire projections |
| **Stream → UI mapping** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/session/acp_session_impl/tool_calls.rs` | `SessionActor::handle_sampling_event` | Text→`AgentMessageChunk`, reasoning→`AgentThoughtChunk`, tool deltas→`ToolCallDeltaChunk` (xAI ext), backend tools→`ToolCall`/`ToolCallUpdate` | `Completed` does not itself emit UI; canonical tool state at turn end | **Adopt** — map provider stream to a stable client protocol early |
| **High-freq vs one-shot emit** | `.../replay_events.rs`, `.../acp_session_impl/updates.rs` | `SessionNotification`, `send_update`, `send_buffered_xai_update`, `send_xai_notification`, `emit_buffered`, `emit_notification_direct` | Buffered: message/thought/tool-delta chunks via `event_tx`→`ReplayBuffer`. Direct: retry, hooks, compaction, mode changes (persist + hooks) | `CurrentModeUpdate` must use FIFO queue, not direct emit — direct mints higher `eventId` and client dedup drops chunks (**silent text loss**) | **Adopt** — strict rule: high-freq buffered, lifecycle one-shot; never bypass ordering for mode toggles |
| **Client chunk merge** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/agent/update_chunk_merge.rs` | `ReplayBuffer`, `BufferingSettings`, `merge_acp_chunks`, `merge_xai_chunks` | Debounce by count/bytes/time; merge same-kind text; flush timer in `run_loop` | Cross-kind or session-id mismatch → force-flush both; missing `agentTimestampMs` → permissive merge window | **Adapt** — debounce layer is client-tunable (`InitializeRequest.meta.bufferingSettings`); ADDOM may use simpler coalesce or renderer-side merge |
| **ACP canonical updates** | `agent_client_protocol` (via shell) | `acp::SessionUpdate`, `acp::SessionNotification` | `AgentMessageChunk`, `AgentThoughtChunk`, `ToolCall`, `ToolCallUpdate`, `Plan`, `CurrentModeUpdate`, etc. | `AvailableCommandsUpdate` persisted but stripped on replay (re-advertised at load) | **Adopt** — persist full history, replay subset for redundant catalog events |
| **xAI extension updates** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/extensions/notification.rs` | `SessionNotification`, `SessionUpdate` | Parallel wire: `RewindMarker`, `CompactionCheckpoint`, `SubagentSpawned`/`Finished`, `RetryState`, `ToolCallDeltaChunk`, usage (`PromptUsage`) | `ToolCallDeltaChunk` **not persisted** — canonical `ToolCall` with assembled `raw_input` is replay truth | **Adopt** — extension namespace for internal events; don’t persist pure deltas |
| **Event identity** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell-base/src/util/event_id.rs` | `generate_event_id`, `ensure_event_id_meta`, `ensure_event_counter_at_least` | Format `{sessionId}-{counter}`; process-global counter; re-seed on resume from `max_event_seq + 1` | Global counter shared across sessions; counter suffix parsed after **last** `-` (session IDs may contain dashes) | **Adapt** — monotonic per-session IDs with resume re-seed; avoid global counter if ADDOM runs isolated workers |
| **Notification meta** | `.../acp_session_impl/updates.rs` | `send_update_full`, `build_notification_meta` | `_meta`: `eventId`, `agentTimestampMs`, `promptId`, `chunkId`, `totalTokens`, `streamStartMs`, `turnStartMs`, `isReplay` | Unstamped persisted lines force **full replay** on cursor reconnect | **Adopt** — stamp before persist/broadcast fork; document chokepoints |
| **Tool-call lifecycle** | `.../acp_session_impl/tool_calls.rs` | `execute_tool_calls`, `prepare_tool_call`, `handle_tool_error` | `Pending` emit → permission/hooks → `InProgress` → `ToolCallUpdate` (`Completed`/`Failed`); observability `ToolCallStarted` | Parallel tool batch: first failure cancels rest with synthetic tool results | **Adopt** — explicit status machine on wire; replay coalesces `ToolCall`+updates |
| **Persistence message bus** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/session/persistence.rs` | `PersistenceMsg`, `PersistenceHandle`, `SessionPersistence` | Single actor serializes all disk writes; `Flush` / `FlushAndAck` barriers | Channel close drops unsent msgs unless `flush_pending` ran; subagents use `PersistenceHandle::noop()` | **Adopt** — dedicated persistence actor + ack barriers before user-visible “saved” |
| **Chat history bridge** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/session/chat_persistence.rs` | `ChannelChatPersistence` | `Chat` append, `ReplaceChatHistory` on compaction, `Flush` | Compaction replaces whole file atomically (separate from updates append) | **Adopt** — dual store: transcript (`chat_history`) vs UI event log (`updates`) |
| **Session storage schema** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/session/storage/jsonl/mod.rs`, `.../storage/mod.rs` | `JsonlStorageAdapter`, `PersistedData`, `SessionUpdateEnvelope` | Dir: `{grok_home}/sessions/{urlencoded_cwd}/{REDACTED_SESSION_ID}/` — `updates.jsonl`, `chat_history.jsonl`, `summary.json`, `plan.json`, `plan_mode.json`, `signals.json`, `rewind_points.jsonl`, `goal/state.json`, compaction dirs | `PersistedDataLight` omits updates + defers rewind points for fast resume | **Adapt** — file layout is Grok-specific; schema ideas (envelope + sidecars) transfer |
| **Append semantics** | `.../storage/jsonl/mod.rs` | `append_jsonl_line`, `write_jsonl` | Updates: append-only with torn-tail newline heal; full rewrites: temp+rename (`rewind_points`, compaction) | Append not crash-atomic — one corrupt line skipped by lenient readers | **Adopt** — JSONL append + torn-record healing; atomic rewrite for truncate-sensitive files |
| **Persistence merge** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/session/persistence.rs` | `maybe_merge_notification`, `flush_pending` | Consecutive agent/thought text chunks merged before disk; xAI updates never merged | Merge only when both chunks lack `_meta`; differs from `ReplayBuffer` merge (two layers) | **Improve** — triple merge (sampler UI buffer + actor + persistence) adds complexity; ADDOM could collapse to one merge point |
| **Rewind / dead-branch filter** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/session/storage/mod.rs` | `filter_rewind_lines`, `filter_rewind_updates`, `UserRunTurnTracker` | `RewindMarker` xAI event truncates timeline at prompt boundary; prompt starts tracked via user chunks + `promptIndex` | Marker without matching prompt start truncates to end; substring pre-scan for performance | **Adopt** — logical truncation over append-only log (markers, not file rewrite) |
| **Replay / resume** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/agent/mvp_agent/mod.rs` | `replay_session_updates`, `prepare_replay_lines`, `forward_raw_replay_line`, `replay_session_updates_from_offset_enqueue` | `session/load`: cursor-based incremental or full replay; `_meta.isReplay`; re-seed event counter; drain gateway completions for ordering | Cursor over id-less tail → full replay; `pending_tool_calls` map coalesces incomplete tool replay | **Adopt** — cursor + `isReplay` + tool-call coalescing on replay |
| **Cross-compaction rewind** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/session/helpers/replay.rs` | `replay_to_prompt`, `find_latest_compaction_checkpoint`, `ReplayState` | Rebuilds `ConversationItem` list from `updates.jsonl` when chat file truncated by compaction | Heavy path; malformed lines skipped with warn | **Adopt** — when transcript compacted, event log + checkpoint files are reconstruction source |
| **Compaction** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/session/compaction.rs`, `crates/common/xai-grok-compaction/` | `SessionActor` compaction methods, `build_compacted_history`, `CompactionCheckpoint` | Auto/manual/inline compact; `ReplaceChatHistory`; checkpoint + segment files; prefire pass-1 cache with prefix fingerprint | Two-pass async prefire can invalidate on rewind/edit | **Adapt** — compaction is large subsystem; adopt checkpoint-in-updates pattern, not full Rust crate |
| **Restart recovery** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/agent/mvp_agent/agent_ops.rs`, `.../persistence.rs` | `begin_session_load`, `wait_for_in_flight_session_load`, `resolve_local_session` | Serialize concurrent loads per session; remote restore dedupes child sessions | Leader death: clients replay via `session/load` (e2e in `test_leader_death_repro.rs`) | **Adopt** — load mutex + orphan task/subagent reconciliation from updates scan |
| **Deduplication** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell-base/src/util/event_id.rs`, `.../storage/mod.rs`, `.../relay/sync.rs` | `prepare_replay_lines` cursor logic, `RelaySync::queue` | Client compares `eventId` counter; relay skips `isReplay`; replay drops stale ACUs | Process-global counter; missing `eventId` on live tail breaks incremental reconnect | **Adopt** concept of monotonic event IDs; **reject** global counter if ADDOM needs per-window isolation |
| **ACP projection** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/session/acp_session_impl/updates.rs`, `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/agent/mvp_agent/mod.rs` | `gateway.forward_fire_and_forget`, `forward_with_completion` | Live: JSON-RPC `session/update`; extensions: `_x.ai/session/update` | Replay uses completion receivers to preserve notification order to client | **Adapt** — ACP gateway → ADDOM IPC/renderer channel with same ordering guarantees |
| **Headless projection** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/extensions/notification.rs`, `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/tests/test_built_binary_e2e.rs` | `project_result_usage`, `attach_result_usage_fail_closed` | Frozen JSON shape: snake_case totals, camelCase `modelUsage`; uncached input tokens; cost omitted when incomplete | Differs from ACP `PromptUsage` (full input incl. cache reads; `costUsdTicks`) | **Adapt** — separate usage projection per consumer; document wire deltas |
| **Workspace event bus** | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-workspace-types/src/events/mod.rs` | `WorkspaceEvent` | Explicitly **no** `SessionEvent` on EventBus — session lifecycle is sampler-owned | Cross-boundary confusion if mixing workspace pub/sub with session updates | **Reject** for session transcript — keep session events out of workspace-wide bus |
| **Tests (representative)** | `.../acp_session_tests/replay_buffer_send_update_tests.rs` | `handle_sampling_event` integration | Buffering, sampling→ACP, completion commit | — | **Adopt** as test matrix template |
| | `.../acp_session_tests/rewind_cross_compaction_tests.rs`, `.../helpers/replay.rs` tests | `replay_to_prompt` | Rewind across compaction boundary | — | |
| | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/tests/session_load_perf.rs` | `full_session_load_e2e`, `load_updates_for_replay_at` | Load perf + replay parse | — | |
| | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/tests/test_xai_session_update.rs` | xAI persist/replay | Extension notifications survive reload | — | |
| | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/tests/test_leader_death_repro.rs`, `test_leader_stdio_integration.rs` | `wait_for_replay_notifications` | Leader crash → `session/load` recovery | — | |
| | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/src/session/storage/mod.rs` (unit tests) | `prepare_replay_lines` | Cursor, ACU stripping, event seq | — | |
| | `crates/codegen/xai-grok-shell/tests/test_built_binary_e2e.rs` | headless JSON/streaming usage | Headless wire contract | — | |

---

## Pipeline Summary (compact)

1. **Parse** — `xai-grok-sampler` L2 transforms emit `SamplingEvent`; terminal `Completed` yields `ConversationResponse` (`collect_response` for non-UI callers).

2. **Project** — `handle_sampling_event` maps to ACP chunks or xAI `ToolCallDeltaChunk`; tool execution uses `ToolCall`/`ToolCallUpdate` lifecycle.

3. **Buffer** — Actor-loop `ReplayBuffer` debounces client-bound chunks; `FlushReplay` + timer flush.

4. **Emit** — `emit_buffered` → `emit_notification_direct` (ACP: persist + gateway); xAI deltas gateway-only, no persist.

5. **Persist** — `PersistenceMsg::Update` → `SessionPersistence` (optional text merge) → `SessionUpdateEnvelope` append to `updates.jsonl`; chat via `PersistenceMsg::Chat` / `ReplaceChatHistory`.

6. **Resume** — `prepare_replay_lines` (rewind filter, cursor, ACU drop, `max_event_seq`) → `forward_raw_replay_line` (tool coalesce, `isReplay`) → `ensure_event_counter_at_least`.

7. **Compact** — Replace `chat_history.jsonl`; write `CompactionCheckpoint` / segments to updates; cross-boundary rewind uses `helpers/replay.rs`.

---

## ADDOM Takeaways (by classification)

| Classification | Items |
|----------------|-------|
| **Adopt** | Append-only event log + separate transcript; monotonic `eventId` with resume re-seed; buffered vs direct emit split; `RewindMarker` logical truncation; `FlushAndAck` persistence barriers; torn JSONL tail healing; replay tool-call coalescing; don’t persist streaming tool deltas |
| **Adapt** | Rust actor/`LocalSet` → ADDOM main-process + IPC; ACP → renderer protocol; `BufferingSettings` client tuning; file paths under `~/.grok`; headless vs UI usage shapes |
| **Improve** | Three merge layers (ReplayBuffer, persistence merge, client dedup) — candidate to simplify; global event counter — per-session or per-leader counter would reduce cross-session coupling |
| **Already covered** | *(Unknown without ADDOM code)* — if ADDOM already has JSONL/session resume and streaming IPC, align naming and id scheme rather than re-plumbing |
| **Reject** | Putting session lifecycle on a workspace-wide `EventBus` (Grok explicitly removed `SessionEvent` there); persisting every tool argument delta; direct emit for mid-stream state that must stay ordered behind queued chunks |

---

## Highest-Risk Ordering Footguns (for ADDOM to avoid)

1. **Emitting lifecycle updates outside the FIFO event queue** while chunks are buffered → client dedup drops newer chunks.
2. **Resume without re-seeding event IDs** → all post-resume live events look “stale.”
3. **Cursor reconnect over unpersisted or unstamped events** → stuck or full replay every time.
4. **Replay forwarding `ToolCall` before terminal `ToolCallUpdate`** → UI shows stuck in-progress tools (`forward_raw_replay_line` guards this).
5. **Assuming `updates.jsonl` equals chat transcript** — after compaction, `chat_history.jsonl` may be shorter; reconstruction goes through checkpoints + updates replay.
